Dear Prof. Tony Marsland and Dr. Ian Frank:

Please find the following postscript file of the manuscript entitled 
 ``Integer Programming Based Algorithm for Peg Solitaire Problems,''
  by Masashi Kiyomi and Tomomi Matsui,
which I would like to submit for CG2000.

I would like to apply for the Student Paper Awards.
I will send a letter of reference confirming student status
  by separate Post.

All correspondence concerning this paper should be
 addressed to:

Masashi KIYOMI 
Department of Mathematical Engineering and Information Physics, 
Graduate School of Engineering, University of Tokyo, 
7-3-1, Hongo, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo, 113, Japan. 
masashi@misojiro.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp

Thank you very much in advance for your assistance.

Sincerely yours,
Masashi KIYOMI
